Also in the lot: a small bare-metal wire stand with a ball finial, two crossbars and a cast block base (no marks seen), and a silver-plated style toast rack with a side ring holder, ball finials and ball feet (tarnished, no hallmark or maker's stamp visible in the photo, so plated rather than sterling is the safe assumption).

Toast rack is tarnished and spotted; wire stand has a dull surface and minor marks.
reason: Known German maker (Junghans Ato-Mat electronic table clock, dial text read) plus two decorative metal pieces; a collectable mid-century clock if it runs.
